workflow.title: Daily unresolved alerts digest to #oncall and critical-unacknowledged escalation
workflow.goal: Each run: read the alerts sheet, post a digest of all unresolved alerts (with severity and service) to the #oncall channel, and if any unresolved critical alert has not been acknowledged for at least one hour at the time of the run, email the requester directly. The flow is scheduled once daily at 08:00, so escalation is checked once per day, not continuously.

assumptions: The run is started every morning at 8:00 by an external scheduler and receives the current time as input.now.
The Slack stand-in channel is named #oncall.
The escalation email goes to the requester's own address, requester@example.test, as the user asked.
Each run evaluates the one-hour rule only at that moment, so an overdue critical alert is emailed at the next daily run (up to about 24 hours after it was raised).
risks: A once-daily schedule cannot meet a requirement to escalate within one hour: a critical alert raised after 08:00 and unacknowledged until the next 08:00 is only escalated then, or not at all if acknowledged or resolved before that. Running this flow hourly would fix this, but the digest would then post hourly too.
An alert that stays unacknowledged across several days is emailed again on each daily run (no memory of earlier emails).
Escalation only happens when the flow runs; if the schedule is missed, overdue critical alerts are not emailed until the next run.
chat.post and outbox.send are non-idempotent and are attempted only once; a failed post needs manual re-run.
Outbound messages require a person's approval when the flow runs live.
successCriteria: The digest lists every alert with resolved=false, including severity and service, and is posted once to #oncall.
Every critical alert with acknowledged=false, resolved=false and age of at least one hour at the run time is included in exactly one escalation email to the requester for that run.
No email is sent when no critical alert is overdue at the run time.

metadata.rationale: Digest is built from the alerts sheet with deterministic filters; the escalation uses the one-hour age rule on unacknowledged critical alerts as of the run time. Both outbound actions are verified by independent re-read. Limitation: the flow runs once daily, so the one-hour rule is only checked daily.
